import re
text5=msgs[5]['message']['content'][0]['text']; text12=msgs[12]['message']['content'][0]['text']
def extract_after(text, label):
    ix=text.index(label)+len(label)
    chunk=text[ix:].lstrip('\n')
    rows=[]
    for line in chunk.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): break
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9 ]+',line.strip()): break
        rows.append([int(x) for x in line.split()])
    return rows
